adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
adds.text: When falling debris mortally wounds Fitz during the rescue of Robin and Polly in Chicago, May stays by his side with Mack as he dies.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend who stays by Fitz's side as he dies.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend May stays beside as he dies in Chicago.
adds.evidence: 5x22 The End: while rescuing Polly and Robin from Qovas' ship, Fitz is mortally wounded by falling debris, May and Mack staying by his side as he dies.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#12
adds.text: After helping seal the rift, Mike stays at the Lighthouse to watch Fitz marry Jemma.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who watches Fitz marry Jemma.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend whose wedding to Jemma Mike stays to watch.
adds.evidence: 5x12 The Real Deal: Deathlok attends Fitz and Simmons' wedding in the underground forest, asking Deke whether he is with the bride or groom; no direct exchange with Fitz is shown.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#12
adds.text: Before going down alone to seal the rift with Fitz's device, Coulson makes Fitz promise to marry Jemma whatever happens, and once the rift is closed he walks Fitz to his wedding.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who makes Fitz promise to marry Jemma and walks him to the wedding.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Coulson makes promise to marry Jemma, whose device seals the rift.
adds.evidence: 5x12 The Real Deal: Fitz gives Coulson the Gravity Containment Device and Coulson has Fitz promise that he and Simmons will marry; afterwards Coulson and Deke accompany Fitz to his wedding.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#11
adds.text: Having made a deal with General Hale, Piper lures the team to the Kree beacon and holds Fitz at gunpoint, then turns back to their side when Hale's robots open fire.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who holds Fitz at gunpoint for Hale, then turns back.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Piper holds at gunpoint for Hale before turning back.
adds.evidence: 5x11 All the Comforts of Home: Piper draws her gun on the team and holds Coulson, Fitz and Simmons at gunpoint as Ruby's robots arrive; when Ruby orders them killed, Piper chooses to help her team escape.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#12
adds.text: May goes out to meet an incoming Quinjet and finds Mike leading the reinforcements Deke called, and he goes down to help Coulson seal the rift.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Leads the reinforcements May meets at the Lighthouse.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who meets Mike's Quinjet when he brings reinforcements.
adds.evidence: 5x12 The Real Deal: May and Daisy go outside to check an incoming Quinjet, which carries the S.H.I.E.L.D. reinforcements gathered by Deke and led by Deathlok; May later attends the wedding with him.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#11
adds.text: Piper tells May she searched everywhere for the team, even keeping watch on May's mother, but she has made a deal with General Hale and leads them into a trap before turning back to their side.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who leads the team into Hale's trap, then turns back.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The agent whose mother Piper watches while searching for the team.
adds.evidence: 5x11 All the Comforts of Home: Piper tells May 'I even had eyes on your families' (May: 'One more thing for my mother to be paranoid about'); Piper then betrays the team to Hale's robots before helping them escape.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#14
adds.text: Ivanov docks with the Zephyr as General Hale's partner and demands that May and her teammates release Hale, and May can only object as Coulson leaves with them.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Hale's partner, who demands May release her and takes Coulson.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The agent the Superior faces down on the Zephyr to free Hale.
adds.evidence: 5x14 The Devil Complex: a Quinjet docks with the Zephyr revealing Ivanov works with Hale; Ivanov explains to May and her teammates they are averting an extinction event and demands Hale's release; May refuses to let Coulson go but he leaves with them.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#12
adds.text: After helping seal the rift, Mike stays at the Lighthouse to watch Jemma marry Fitz.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend whose wedding to Fitz Mike stays to watch.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who watches Jemma marry Fitz.
adds.evidence: 5x12 The Real Deal: Deathlok attends Fitz and Simmons' wedding in the underground forest; no direct exchange with Simmons is shown.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#12
adds.text: Answering Deke's call for backup, Mike reaches the rift in time to save Coulson, and the two fight off the fear manifestations together until Coulson seals it.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend Mike saves at the rift and fights beside.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Arrives at the rift to save Coulson and fights beside him.
adds.evidence: 5x12 The Real Deal: the real Deathlok, brought by Deke, destroys the manifestation dragging Coulson to the rift; Coulson and Deathlok destroy the Lash, Vrellnexian and Hive manifestations and Coulson closes the rift.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#14
adds.text: Ivanov comes for General Hale at the Zephyr, and when Coulson agrees to go with them, Ivanov makes him wear a mask and hand over his prosthetic hand as Coulson needles him about his faceless robots.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Hale's partner, who takes Coulson to her base under guard.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The agent the Superior takes to Hale's base and searches for weapons.
adds.evidence: 5x14 The Devil Complex: Ivanov arrives to free Hale; Coulson agrees to go with them; on the Quinjet Ivanov orders Coulson to put on a mask and hand over his prosthetic hand to be scanned, and Coulson questions why his Sleeper Mechs lack his face; Hale reveals she holds Ivanov's head.

owner_calls.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#12
owner_calls.question: Mike is a guest at Fitz and Jemma's wedding but no line passes between him and either of them. Does attending their wedding count as dealing with each other?
owner_calls.evidence: 5x12: Deathlok watches the ceremony and talks only with Deke, asking if he is with the bride or groom.
